brand.notes: Client said: navy blue and gold, and wants the site to look like the earlier yourtaxnerd.com, facelifted. Kept from the earlier site: brand blue #3A69B1 header, yellow #FFC402 buttons, Montserrat and Plus Jakarta Sans, light blue bands (#EAF2FF), navy testimonial band (#0F1E3D) with the gold ornament, service cards with a blue icon tab and yellow bar, FAQ pills, the cartoon tax nerd logo. #2F5FA7 is the darker blue for small labels on light backgrounds; #5AAEFF highlights words on navy (like "Superpower" on the earlier site); #0A1428 is the footer and top bar. Not reused from the earlier site: its stock photos, its generated city background, and its unverified numbers (999+ clients, 1,200+ returns, 10+ years, 98% retention).
